gap: No result ChatGPT got states today's enclosure prices for the whole field side by side: the UGREEN DXP6800 Pro is $1,099.99 at UGREEN's store, a Synology DS1825+ made 10GbE-capable costs $1,616.98 ($1,486.99 plus the $129.99 E10G30-T1 card), the QNAP TVS-h874T i7 is $3,089.00 at QNAP's own US store, the Asustor Lockerstor 6 Gen3 is $1,770.99, and both TerraMaster 10GbE Max models are sold out at TerraMaster today.
standout_why: WunderTech (cited) and esp32.co.uk (cited) give no prices at all, only 'check price' links. The Post Flow (uncited, rank 5) prices three units (QNAP TS-473A, UGREEN DXP4800 Plus, DXP8800 Plus) with September 2026 text prices. ChatGPT's answer priced three units (DXP4800 Plus $619.99, DS1825+ $1,486.99, TVS-h874T $3,089) and gave no price for its 'best overall' DXP6800 Pro. None of them adds the Synology 10GbE card cost, prices the QNAP units from QNAP's own store, prices the Asustor Gen3 or Flashstor Gen2, or notes that TerraMaster's F4-424 Max and F6-424 Max are out of stock.
decides: Confirms the DXP6800 Pro as the pick: at $1,099.99 it is the cheapest enclosure in the field with two 10GbE ports and Thunderbolt 4 built in, $517 under a DS1825+ plus 10GbE card, $671 under the Lockerstor 6 Gen3, $699 under the QNAP TBS-h574TX i5U, and $1,989 under the TVS-h874T i7. It keeps the DXP4800 Plus as the budget pick at $619.99 because the nearest 10GbE rival at that tier, TerraMaster's F4-424 Max at $899.99, is sold out at TerraMaster today. The DXP8800 Plus at $1,369.99 undercuts every 8-bay rival once 10GbE is included.
